description: This Java class implements a service for managing JWT settings, including saving, reloading, and retrieving JWT configuration, with integration to admin settings and cluster broadcasting.

classes.name: DefaultJwtSettingsService
classes.description: Service class for managing JWT settings, including persistence, validation, and cluster notification.

methods.name: saveJwtSettings
methods.description: Validates and saves new JWT settings, updates admin settings, and broadcasts change event.

methods.name: reloadJwtSettings
methods.description: Reloads JWT settings from database and refreshes token factory.

methods.name: getJwtSettings
methods.description: Retrieves current JWT settings, optionally forcing reload.

methods.name: getJwtSettings(boolean forceReload)
methods.description: Internal method to get JWT settings with optional forced reload.

methods.name: getJwtSettingsFromDb
methods.description: Fetches JWT settings from admin settings database.

methods.name: mapAdminToJwtSettings
methods.description: Converts AdminSettings object to JwtSettings object.

methods.name: mapJwtToAdminSettings
methods.description: Converts JwtSettings object to AdminSettings for persistence.

methods.name: isSigningKeyDefault
methods.description: Checks if the signing key in JwtSettings is the default key.

methods.name: validateKeyLength
methods.description: Validates if the provided key length meets the minimum required length.
